title: nan
authors: Hou Z.; Xue C.; Chen S.; Xu C.; Jiang C.; Niu J.
key_contribution: Proposes a consistent-innovation-aided distributed cooperative localization method for multi-UAV navigation in GNSS-denied environments using UWB cooperative constraints with SINS, validated in simulation.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
